description: Expander for Permutation, placed immediately to its right, which mixes the first eight bits of Permutation's shift register into a positive and a negative voltage

params.text: Sets how much of the bit mix reaches the NEG output, from none of it to all of it
Sets how much of the bit mix reaches the POS output, from none of it to all of it
Sets how much that bit adds to the mix while it is a one; while that bit is a zero it adds nothing, wherever this knob is turned

inputs.text: Adds to the POS knob, 5V here covering the knob's full travel
Adds to the NEG knob, 5V here covering the knob's full travel

outputs.text: The mix of the knobs whose bits are ones, inverted, scaled by the NEG knob and clipped at -10V
The mix of the knobs whose bits are ones, scaled by the POS knob and clipped at 10V

notes: a second Variant placed immediately to the right of this one is passed the same eight bits, so several can be chained from one Permutation
the bits come from the Permutation immediately to the left; with no Permutation there both outputs rest at 0V
